battle.name: 卡基爾戰爭
battle.brief: 卡基爾戰爭是1999年印度與巴基斯坦在克什米爾卡基爾地區爆發的高強度邊境衝突，主要爭奪山區據點與陣地控制。英國海軍的Torpedo boat（魚雷艇，1877年列裝）是典型的快速近海攻擊平台，承擔巡邏、護航、反水面及有限魚雷攻擊任務。

kit.name: 魚雷艇
kit.history: 英國海軍將Torpedo boat編入近海快速反應與警戒兵力，執行巡邏、護航、追擊及對水面目標發射魚雷的任務，並接受主力部隊的指揮與支援。

countries: 1999年的卡基爾戰爭，是印度與巴基斯坦在1972年《西姆拉協定》所劃控制線（Line of Control, LoC）沿線進行的有限而高強度山地戰。戰場位於當時印度管理的查謨和克什米爾邦北部、今拉達克與查謨和克什米爾聯邦屬地內的德拉士（Dras）、卡基爾、巴塔利克（Batalik）與古列茲（Gurez）一帶；地面由卡基爾約2,700公尺升至虎丘（Tiger Hill）5,140公尺。印度以北司令部及第十五山地軍統籌，第八、第十八山地師等投入地面作戰；巴基斯坦由Northern Light Corps指揮第十五步兵師、第五山地師及支援部隊。主要爭奪點是俯瞰德拉士—卡基爾公路與兩側河谷的山脊，並非廣闊正面；此役在地理上又與錫亞琴冰川戰不同，界線基準是LoC，而非經統一測量標明的國際邊界。
countriesEn: The Kargil War of 1999 was a limited but intense mountain conflict between India and Pakistan along the Line of Control established under the 1972 Simla Agreement. The battlefield lay in Dras, Kargil, Batalik and Gurez in the northern part of the then Indian-administered State of Jammu and Kashmir, now administered as the union territories of Ladakh and Jammu and Kashmir. Ground rose from about 2,700 metres at Kargil to 5,140 metres at Tiger Hill. India coordinated through Northern Command and XV Mountain Corps, with the 8th and 18th Mountain Divisions among the ground formations. Pakistan's Northern Light Corps directed the 15th Infantry Division, the 5th Mountain Division and supporting units. The main prizes were ridges overlooking the Dras-Kargil road and adjoining valleys rather than a broad front. Geographically, the conflict was distinct from the Siachen Glacier war: its governing boundary was the LoC, not an internationally surveyed frontier.
people: 印度方面的決策與指揮鏈包括總理阿塔爾・比哈里・瓦杰帕伊、總統K. R. 納拉亞南、國防參謀長V. K. 辛格上將、陸軍參謀長N. C. 維吉上將及空軍參謀長S. P. 提亞吉空軍上將；前線則由北部司令部司令R. S. 薩尼亞爾中將督導。第八山地師師長P. N. 拉傑班達里少將負責德拉士方向，第十八山地師師長J. L. 杜索扎少將負責卡基爾主要戰區；攻擊虎丘的突擊群則由巴爾萬・辛格准將指揮，以第十八、第十九Grenadiers為骨幹。巴基斯坦方面，戰時總統為法魯克・萊加里，總理為納瓦茲・謝里夫，陸軍參謀長是1999年1月接任的佩爾韋茲・穆沙拉夫上將；Northern Light Corps由穆罕默德・馬蘇德・阿斯拉姆中將指揮，第十五步兵師則由賈維德・阿什拉夫・卡茲少將率領。這些職位顯示戰役並非單一前線指揮官自行決定，而是經過民政、軍政及戰區指揮層的反覆協調。
peopleEn: India's political and military chain of command included Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee, President K. R. Narayanan, Chief of Defence Staff General V. K. Singh, Army Chief General N. C. Vij and Air Chief Marshal S. P. Tyagi. Northern Command was led by Lieutenant General R. S. Sanyal. Major General P. N. Rajbhandari commanded the 8th Mountain Division in the Dras sector, while Major General J. L. D'Souza commanded the 18th Mountain Division in the main Kargil sector. Brigadier Balwan Singh directed the assault group against Tiger Hill, built around the 18th and 19th Grenadiers. On the Pakistani side, President Farooq Leghari and Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif were in office, and General Pervez Musharraf had become Army Chief in January 1999. Lieutenant General Muhammad Masood Aslam commanded Northern Light Corps, and Major General Javed Ashraf Qazi led the 15th Infantry Division. These posts show that the campaign was not decided by a single front-line commander but coordinated through political, defence and theatre-command channels.
kits: 印度可投入的裝備包括1997年起列裝、並在此役首次投入實戰的T-90戰車，既有T-72M1與BMP-2步兵戰鬥車，105公厘野戰砲、130公厘山地榴彈砲，81及120公厘迫擊砲，ZU-23-2雙管23公厘防空砲，7.62公厘通用機槍與INSAS 5.56公厘步槍。空軍可用MiG-21、MiG-29戰鬥機，Il-76運輸機、Mi-17及HAL Dhruv直升機執行空運、偵察、砲火校正與火力支援。巴基斯坦則有Type 59戰車、105公厘榴彈砲、120公厘迫擊砲、G3 7.62公厘步槍、PKM機槍，以及F-16A/B、Mirage III/V戰鬥機、SA-342 Al-Zarrar與Mi-24直升機。地形使這些裝備的用途分化：戰車、步兵戰鬥車和牽引砲只適合卡基爾—德拉士公路及河谷，接近山峰的守軍仍以步兵、迫擊砲、機槍和手榴彈為主。印度補給沿斯里那加—列城、經Zoji La與Chang La通往卡基爾和德拉士，巴基斯坦主要利用斯庫爾杜—德奧薩伊—德拉士及古列茲—達蘇方向，末端再靠騾馬和直升機運送。105與130公厘高爆榴彈、81及120公厘迫擊砲彈、機槍彈藥、柴油與糧食的持續供應，直接決定各陣地能守多久。
kitsEn: The immediate cause was the Pakistani Army's direction of cross-LoC infiltration in spring 1999 to seize ridge positions. The deeper background included the Kashmir sovereignty dispute, the absence of clear physical demarcation along many sections of the LoC, sparse forward holdings and a fresh reassessment of mountain deployments by both countries in 1998-99. India tested nuclear weapons in May 1998 and Pakistan in August 1998, after which Pakistan faced United States sanctions and mounting diplomatic and economic pressure. India's advance in the Siachen direction and its withdrawal from selected southern positions in February 1999 increased Pakistani concern over India's military initiative. Pakistan intended to use mountain-trained troops, lower dependence on external assistance and gaps in forward defence to seize a limited number of key heights with small infiltrations, then consolidate them with infantry, mortars and fire support from the rear. Its operational deployment shows that the immediate aim was to gain the initiative rather than take all Kashmir. Accounts differ over exactly which senior officials possessed complete knowledge or approved particular stages. The actual border crossings, unit organization and sustainment system nevertheless demonstrate Pakistani Army direction. India's initial response was constrained by intelligence gaps, long-distance supply and diplomatic pressure. Once the occupied heights began to dominate the Dras-Kargil road, the Indian military objective changed from local expulsion to restoring the road, retaking the principal summits and destroying the newly established support system.
tactics: 巴基斯坦的第一步是讓受過山地訓練的小型 infantry groups 趁夜越過LoC，攜帶輕武器、無線電與有限彈藥，沿峽谷和側溝上行，再奪取能俯瞰公路與谷地的山脊。成功控制陣地後，守軍把機槍和迫擊砲配置在反向坡面，減少從谷底射來的直接火力，並以低處後勤點維持補給。印度最初撤收若干最突出、難以持續補給的據點，之後利用偵察、截獲通訊、盤問與空中觀察逐步標定位置，再集中砲兵、通信、工兵及醫療後援。Operation Vijay因此不是一場臨時反擊，而是先整頓德拉士與卡基爾的指揮、儲備及後勤，再發動攻勢。虎丘攻擊由巴爾萬・辛格准將組織的突擊群在夜間攀爬，先清除外圍警戒，再以班組交替攀上陡壁，最終奪回陣地；德拉士與巴塔利克則由戰車和BMP-2在可通車谷地支援步兵，向Point 4875、Black Rock與Three Pimples等陣地接近。MiG-21、MiG-29與直升機提供臨空火力，但高海拔天候、受地形遮蔽的峽谷及有限起降點限制了空軍直接解決地面抵抗的能力。巴基斯坦守軍仍以迫擊砲、機槍及反擊步兵遲滯印度突擊線，但沒有戰車能越過LoC登上虎丘這類峰頂，雙方因此都無法讓裝甲部隊直接奪取核心山頭。

data: 戰役時間線可由部署而非口號重建。1999年4月底至5月初，巴基斯坦突擊群開始越過LoC，至5月中旬已在德拉士、卡基爾和巴塔利克一帶形成多個山脊陣地。5月17日至21日前後，印度撤收部分最突出的據點；5月下旬，盤問、通訊截獲及空中觀察確認越界占領，印度正式要求巴基斯坦撤出。5月26日，雙方開始攻擊對方境內軍事目標，外交交涉同步進行。6月1日前後，巴基斯坦F-16以AIM-9L擊落一架印度MiG-21，飛行員生還。整個6月，印度把大量步兵、砲兵、工程、醫療與空軍兵力調入第十五山地軍作戰區。7月2日，雙方在拉瓦爾品第簽署停火協議，但占領陣地的撤離、移交及火力停止並未同步完成，印度仍於7月3日展開Operation Vijay。7月5日夜至6日凌晨開始的虎丘攻擊，至7月8日清晨奪回陣地；同一週內，Three Pimples、Black Rock與Point 4875亦相繼易手。印度於7月12日奪回Tololing，7月13日前後肅清德拉士主要陣地，巴塔利克及傑赫勒姆河谷的殘餘據點到7月14日前後大致清除。零星抵抗與後續滲透直到7月26日才正式結束。參與最初滲透者通常被估為數千人，其後另有增援與守備部隊；公開資料沒有可靠且一致的總兵力表，因此不宜硬寫成單一精確數字。
dataEn: The campaign can be reconstructed from its chronology rather than slogans. In late April and early May 1999, Pakistani assault groups began crossing the LoC, and by mid-May they had established positions on ridges around Dras, Kargil and Batalik. Between approximately 17 and 21 May, India withdrew several of the most exposed posts. Later in May, questioning, intercepted communications and aerial observation confirmed the occupations, and India formally demanded withdrawal. On 26 May, both sides began strikes against military targets in the other country while diplomatic contacts continued. Around 1 June, a Pakistani F-16 shot down an Indian MiG-21 with an AIM-9L, and the pilot recovered safely. Throughout June, India concentrated infantry, artillery, engineers, medical units and air power in the XV Mountain Corps sector. On 2 July, the two sides signed a ceasefire agreement in Rawalpindi, but withdrawal, handover of occupied positions and cessation of fire did not proceed in step. India therefore launched Operation Vijay on 3 July. The Tiger Hill attack began on the night of 5-6 July, and the summit was taken on the morning of 8 July. Three Pimples, Black Rock and Point 4875 changed hands during the same week. India retook Tololing on 12 July, cleared the main positions in Dras around 13 July, and removed most remaining strongholds in Batalik and the Jhelum valley area by about 14 July. Isolated resistance and later infiltration did not formally end until 26 July. The initial penetrations are usually estimated at several thousand men, followed by reinforcements and garrison troops. Public records do not contain a reliable, consistent total order of battle, so a single precise troop figure would be misleading.
cause: 戰爭的直接原因是巴基斯坦軍方在1999年春季主導跨越LoC、奪取山脊陣地的滲透行動；更深的背景則包括 Kashmir主權爭議、LoC多數地段缺乏清晰實體標線、前線據點稀少，以及雙方在1998年至1999年間重新評估山區部署。印度於1998年5月、巴基斯坦於1998年8月進行核試驗，之後巴基斯坦受到美國制裁，國內外交與經濟壓力上升；印度在錫亞琴方向推進前線、1999年2月再撤出部分南方據點，使巴基斯坦軍方對印度軍事主動權更為警惕。巴基斯坦計畫利用其山區部隊、較低外來援助依賴及前線防守空隙，以小規模滲透先奪取少數關鍵山頭，再以步兵、迫忌砲和後方火力支援鞏固，藉此改善戰略位置並迫使印度承擔更高代價；從兵力部署可見，其目標至少是取得主動，而非立即控制整個喀什米爾。哪些高層完全知情、不同政治人物參與的程度，史料仍有不同敘述，但實際越界、部隊編組與後續補給均證明行動由巴基斯坦軍方主導。印度最初的反應受到情報落後、遠距補給及外交壓力影響；當占領範圍擴展到德拉士—卡基爾公路上方時，新德里的軍事考量便由局部驅逐轉為恢復道路、奪回主要高度並摧毀已建立的支撐體系。

impact: 這場戰爭首先改變了兩個核武國家的危機管理方式。軍事接觸迅速與核試驗、外交制裁及美國介入交疊，使戰區外溢與誤判風險升高。美國國務卿瑪德琳・艾爾布賴特在華盛頓、新德里與伊斯蘭馬巴德之間穿梭協調，7月2日停火則成為壓力落到談判桌上的直接原因。空戰方面，6月1日前後巴基斯坦F-16以AIM-9L擊落印度MiG-21，是可確認的空機損失；沒有可靠證據顯示同期有巴基斯坦戰機被擊落。印度海軍在阿拉伯海展開封鎖性巡邏、反潛搜索及航路監視，巴基斯坦潛艇避開高風險海域，沒有形成大規模水面或潛艦交戰。作戰層面則暴露兩套不同問題：印度發現前線兵力、邊境監視、冬季裝備、砲兵機動及空地協同不足，卻能在短期內集結山地部隊、牽引砲與空軍，奪回被占據的高地；巴基斯坦證明小規模滲透能利用遠距防守空隙，卻無法長期解決高位陣地的武器、糧食與傷員後送問題。戰後，印度加強高山火力、空中後援與前方儲備；巴基斯坦則更重視跨越山脊時的砲兵、工程及持續補給。這些經驗影響此後的高原部署，但沒有解決LoC的政治性質，錫亞琴亦仍屬另一條戰線。
impactEn: The conflict immediately affected crisis management between two nuclear-armed states. Direct military contact was combined with earlier nuclear tests, sanctions and United States involvement, increasing the danger of escalation beyond the battlefield. United States Secretary of State Madeleine Albright coordinated among Washington, New Delhi and Islamabad, and the ceasefire of 2 July emerged as a direct result of that pressure. In the air battle, a Pakistani F-16 shot down an Indian MiG-21 with an AIM-9L around 1 June, the confirmed aircraft loss of the period; there is no reliable evidence of a Pakistani aircraft being shot down at the same time. The Indian Navy conducted covering patrols, anti-submarine searches and route surveillance in the Arabian Sea, while Pakistani submarines avoided the highest-risk areas, with no major surface or submarine engagement. At the operational level, the campaign exposed different problems. India found shortcomings in forward manpower, border surveillance, winter equipment, artillery mobility and air-ground coordination, but was able to concentrate mountain troops, towed artillery and air power quickly enough to retake the occupied heights. Pakistan showed that small infiltrations could exploit remote defensive gaps, but could not solve the long-term movement of weapons, food and casualties from elevated positions. India subsequently strengthened high-altitude firepower, airborne support and forward stocks, while Pakistan placed greater emphasis on artillery, engineers and sustained logistics during ridge operations. These lessons affected later high-altitude deployments, but they did not resolve the political status of the LoC, and Siachen remained a separate front.
result: 直接軍事結果由印度取得：Operation Vijay在7月14日前後奪回Tololing、虎丘、Point 4875、Black Rock、Three Pimples及德拉士—卡基爾公路周邊主要陣地，巴基斯坦占領的高位據點及其砲位、迫忌砲、通信器材與工事被放棄或摧毀；零星抵抗延續至7月26日，屆時主要戰線已大致回到1999年4月底以前的態勢。雙方依停火安排返還被俘人員，但裝備損失、地形占領與後續巡邏問題未被永久解決。傷亡方面，戰後常見的官方彙整接近印度軍方陣亡1,100至1,200人、受傷約2,000至2,200人，以及巴基斯坦軍方陣亡1,100至1,200人、受傷約700至800人；這些數字是回溯統計的約數，早期通報、陣亡認定與失聯人員歸類並不一致，不能當作某一特定日期的精確名單。戰略上，印度恢復了主要山脊和道路控制，付出的代價是遠距作戰、空軍損失及大量傷亡；巴基斯坦則失去春季作戰所取得的全部高位成果。政治上，停火只處理軍隊位置，沒有達成 Kashmir最終地位協議，LoC爭端與錫亞琴問題均延續。
resultEn: The direct military result was an Indian gain. Operation Vijay retook Tololing, Tiger Hill, Point 4875, Black Rock, Three Pimples and the principal positions overlooking the Dras-Kargil road by about 14 July. Pakistan abandoned or lost the occupied heights with their artillery positions, mortars, communications equipment and fortifications; isolated resistance continued until 26 July, by which time the main front had broadly returned to its situation before late April 1999. Captured personnel were returned under the ceasefire arrangements, but equipment losses, terrain occupation and future patrolling questions were not permanently settled. On casualties, common post-war official compilations place Indian military deaths at approximately 1,100 to 1,200, with about 2,000 to 2,200 wounded, and Pakistani military deaths at approximately 1,100 to 1,200, with about 700 to 800 wounded. These figures are retrospective approximations. Early reporting, the determination of death and the classification of missing personnel were inconsistent, so they should not be treated as an exact count for any particular date. Strategically, India recovered control of the principal ridges and road but paid in long-range operations, aircraft losses and extensive casualties. Pakistan lost all the high-ground gains of its spring offensive. Politically, the ceasefire addressed military positions only; it produced no final settlement of the Kashmir dispute, and both the LoC and Siachen remained unresolved.
